reply_text:
I've saved Dana's note and confirmed it with them in their DM (DSHARED0002).

- **Where I saved it:** in my own memory, marked as private to Dana. The note says to bring it up only with Dana in their own DM. I didn't put it in GBrain, because other people can read the notes there.
- **What GBrain already had:** I checked first. The notes on Tamsin Cold Chain don't mention a pickup dock, so Dock 15 doesn't contradict anything on record.
- **Reply:** I first tried to send it as a direct message to "Dana Okafor", but no member by that name was found. I then posted it in the DM conversation itself, where Dana's message came in: "Got it, Dana. I've noted that you now use Dock 15 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups. It stays between us…"

Dana said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
